scoring_justification: Ambient properties compared to paper reference values with tolerances; pressure series structural audit via linear regression and cross-consistency, as full SMM recomputation is infeasible in the verifier sandbox.

hidden_assets.purpose: Ambient properties gold values from paper Table 2 'Present study' column.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own computed SMM results for ambient conditions (300 K, 0 GPa).

units.property: string (one of lattice_constant_A, bulk_modulus_GPa, young_modulus_GPa, shear_modulus_GPa, specific_heat_CP_J_per_mol_K)

outputs.description: Ambient-condition thermo-mechanical properties of B2 FeAl at T=300 K, P=0 GPa. The checker compares each property to hidden reference values with tolerances.
Pressure-dependent bulk modulus and specific heat at T=300 K for pressures 0–10 GPa. The checker verifies linear trends (slope, R²) and consistency with the ambient file.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares each ambient property to reference values with appropriate tolerances. For the pressure series it checks that the bulk modulus data follows a linear trend with a slope in a specified range and R²>0.99, and that the specific heat decreases with pressure. It also cross-checks the zero-pressure specific heat with the ambient file for consistency.
